reason: New impact>=4 item this cycle (2026-07-17 11:00 PKT checkpoint): Lotte Chemical Pakistan (LOTCHEM) posted Q2CY26 results (six months ended Jun 30, 2026) per its PSX Data Portal (DPS) company page - Q2-alone EPS of Rs1.87 (vs Q1 2026 EPS of Rs0.97), Q2 profit-after-tax of PKR 2.84bn (vs Q1's PKR 1.47bn) - and Express Tribune/Dawn both reported a cash dividend of Rs1.50/share was declared alongside the results, which the desk's fixed news scale treats as impact 4 (material earnings surprise + dividend announcement).
